description: A Java class for a joystick-based physics game view, including game logic, rendering, and input handling.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: Custom View implementing a joystick-controlled space shooter game with game logic, rendering, and input handling.

classes.name: Sprite
classes.description: Abstract base class for game objects with position, velocity, size, and collision detection.

classes.name: Ship
classes.description: Represents the player's spaceship, handles movement, drawing, and destruction animation.

classes.name: Bullet
classes.description: Represents bullets fired by the ship, handles movement and rendering.

classes.name: Obstacle
classes.description: Represents obstacles in the game, handles movement, rendering, and destruction.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Resets the game when the view size changes.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key press events for directional controls and firing.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key release events to stop movement.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Starts or stops animation based on window focus.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires a bullet from the ship.

methods.name: getVibrator
methods.description: Returns the device vibrator, system vibrator if input device lacks one.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Advances game state and schedules next frame.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Updates game objects' positions, handles collisions, and spawns obstacles.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders game objects onto the canvas.

methods.name: pythag
methods.description: Calculates hypotenuse for given x and y.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Interpolates between two color component values.

methods.name: setPaintARGBBlend
methods.description: Sets paint color with alpha blending.
